title: Kissed Venezuelan Cheese Flatbread
description: A festive, sugar‑free Venezuelan flatbread with a sour béchamel base, melting cheese, and a glossy egg‑washed finish, perfect for any meal.
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, salt, yeast, and stir.
Add water gradually and mix until dough forms and is slightly sticky.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth.
Let dough rise covered in a warm spot for 20 minutes until doubled in size.
Preheat a tava or griddle over medium heat and lightly oil it.
Divide risen dough into 2 portions and roll each into a flat disc about 15cm in diameter.
Pour the béchamel sauce over each disc, sprinkle with shredded cheese, and cook for 3 minutes.
Flip the flatbread, cook until golden and cheese melts (about 3-4 minutes per side), brush with egg wash, and serve warm.
